name: Creamy Garlic Herb Pork Chops
nutrition_note: Source publishes 497 cal, 32g protein, 7g total carbs per serving. Almond-flour dredge + cream/wine/thyme pan sauce; no starch base.
ingredients: Salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (or 1/4 cup almond flour, or 1/4 teaspoon Xanthan Gum)
why: Chop lane, distinct non-tuscan option mid-band (497 cal / 32g protein / 7g carbs). Almond-flour-dredged pan-seared chops in a garlic-herb cream pan sauce - no rice/pasta/potato, batch-scalable skillet. Two genuine unmapped signature ingredients (almond flour dredge, dry white wine) that exercise the pricer lane as intended. Board covers pork-chops, butter, parmesan, heavy-cream, chicken-broth(stock), garlic, italian-seasoning, lemons; xanthan gum is an optional thickener alternative.
